propositions: Three independent detached-child spawn sites repeat identical logic (PYTHONPATH bootstrap, -c re-entry stub, detach flags, stdio discipline, never-raise wrapper) creating maintenance burden and defect propagation risk (bug 3198-438c-72a5-470f propagated to all three by copy-paste)

A single spawn_detached() helper in src/rebar/_proc.py consolidates the PYTHONPATH bootstrap, platform detach flags, durable cwd anchoring, and re-raise semantics; callers supply only entry point, stderr sink, and env
A static source scan test enforces that detached-spawn signature tokens (DETACHED_PROCESS/CREATE_NO_WINDOW and sys.path.insert re-entry) appear only in _proc.py, preventing future copy-paste
Caller exception handling and env construction (including push.py's secret-stripping) remain per-site; the helper does not change exception surface or collapse secrets
The cwd fallback in _config_sources.repo_root retains its raising posture; detached children anchor to durable cwd and long-lived in-process work must pass explicit or set REBAR_ROOT
